whatItDoes: Turns a list of target companies into personalized outreach that follows up on its own. It finds a real contact at each company, verifies the address, writes a first line from what it learned, and stops the moment someone replies.
longDescription: Give it a list of companies, one domain each and optionally a person, and it handles the cold outreach prep. It finds a real contact through email search (`findEmail` when you name the person, `domainSearch` when you don't), reads each site for context, and asks a model (`models.run`) to write an opener per prospect, checking every address for deliverability. It then runs the sequence itself, pausing durably between touches, and drops anyone the moment they reply. Set `dryRun` to research and write without sending.
notes:
Click **Use this template**. Sapiom builds and deploys it for you; open it on the **Agents** page and run it.

It runs with no setup. Given no `leads` it works three built-in demo companies instead, and sends the personalized first touch to this agent's own Sapiom-hosted inbox. Open it to read a real, personalized draft. Give it `leads`, an array of `{ domain, company?, fullName? }`, and it enriches, personalizes, verifies, and starts the drip against real contacts instead. Set `senderName` for the signature, `sequence` to override the default three touches, and `dripIntervalDays` for the gap between them (default 3). Pass `dryRun: true` to research and write every opener and get the plan back **without sending, persisting, or waiting**.

This template **pauses between touches** and resumes on its own when the interval passes. To end the drip early when a prospect replies, fire the `reply.received` signal with the MCP `workflow_signal` tool (or the API), passing `{ "email": "prospect@their-co.com" }` and the run's `executionId` as the `correlationId`. There is no one-click signal button yet. To run it on a cadence over a fresh lead batch, attach the `schedule` as a cron trigger on the deployed agent.

Prefer to work from the code? Run it locally with `run_local` and `dryRun: true` to trace enrich, scrape, personalize, verify (capabilities stubbed), or edit and deploy it with the Sapiom MCP.

zeroSetup.narrative: Works 3 built-in demo leads end to end: enrichment and verification are simulated for these fabricated companies, but the opener comes from a real model call and the first touch is a real, inspectable send to this agent's own Sapiom-hosted demo inbox. Pass your own `leads` to run a real campaign, including the multi-touch drip and reply-to-stop.
